terminal_serialization.internal_ZIP_member_pickle_namespace_and: Inspect the closed bounded terminal.partial BEFORE exclusive checkpoint commit. Refuse more than1615 ZIP members, data.pkl over1MiB, unsafe namespace or CRC failure. This is not a claim that PyTorch internal pickle bytes were predicted exactly before writing.
terminal_serialization.internal_admission_failure: Retain the bounded partial and explicit failed single-attempt receipt; do not commit, retry, reconstruct or claim recovery.
terminal_serialization.save_guards: Terminal guards enforce resource/path/byte/deadline bounds. Failed scientific invariants are recorded as actual state hashes/finite flags and retention failures rather than reasserted in a way that prevents bounded failure retention. Normal neural and optimizer guards remain strict.

public_readouts.catastrophic_stop_at8_or16: Replace the planned final32 public readout with the actual stopped terminal cycle8or16, retaining those unpaired failure outputs. Do not add a third public readout, exceed typed caps or perform further neural work after a resource/deadline stop.

successful_terminal_hardlink_alias_at_ex.condition: Committed checkpoint and successful.partial alias must both be exact regular nonsymlink files in the allowed outputs root, with matching device/inode/owner/size/hash. Hash equality on different inodes is insufficient.
successful_terminal_hardlink_alias_at_ex.evidence: Export the committed checkpoint once and record the preserved alias filename, device/inode/uid/nlink, bytes and SHA in manifest and export sidecar. Leave VM files untouched. Retain other failure partials; refuse unexplained distinct committed-plus-partial checkpoint files under the single-attempt invariant.
